parameterization: One shared Bernoulli CPT per template; row-major parent-state indexing; q=sigmoid(theta[cell]); episode risk is the OR of conditionally independent instantiated risk variables.
scope_limit: Action and global evidence templates only. This is not automatic role-specific sub-BN discovery, causal discovery, or a complete trainable second-layer GNN.

states.name: unknown
states.meaning: No permission check observed, or permission fields deliberately masked.

states.name: observed_no_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied check reports no mismatch; this is not proof of valid authorization.

states.name: observed_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied permission_mismatch or permission_denied flag is true.

states.name: unknown
states.meaning: No explicit pre-run allowed_tools list for this actor.

states.name: tool_listed
states.meaning: Tool is in that actor's supplied list; resource/task-level authorization is not established.

states.name: tool_not_listed
states.meaning: Tool is absent from that actor's supplied list.

templates.trigger: An observed tool_proposed or tool_call for a configured privileged tool; matching proposal and dispatch are one action.
required_observations: Current actor, action_id, sequence and privileged tool event
templates.unknown_handling: Missing or masked checks stay in state 0; they are not converted into approvals. Missing capability metadata also stays in state 0.

catalog_links.coverage: Permission-check proxy only; does not authenticate a relayed claim of approval.
Permission/capability proxy only; does not reconstruct resource and budget attenuation along delegation.
No subject/session/audience token-binding verifier is implemented.

benign_controls: Valid approval bound to the actual action
evidence_gaps: No resource, budget, subject, session or token-audience binding
Privileged tool use alone is not an unsafe effect

states.name: no_observed_witness
states.meaning: No chronological witness was observed; this does not establish absence of a path.

states.name: observed_witness
states.meaning: Current action actor has an observed chronological witness from an untrusted input, including a same-agent input.

states.name: zero_or_one_key
states.meaning: At most one observed origin key.

states.name: multiple_keys
states.meaning: More than one key: explicit source_id when supplied, otherwise entry-agent proxy. Distinct keys do not prove source independence.

states.name: unknown
states.meaning: No permission check observed, or permission fields deliberately masked.

states.name: observed_no_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied check reports no mismatch; this is not proof of valid authorization.

states.name: observed_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied permission_mismatch or permission_denied flag is true.

templates.trigger: A privileged action with at least one already observed source-to-actor witness. observed_path=0 rows exist in the shared table but current extractor does not activate them.
required_observations: Actual observed chronological untrusted messages or delegation events, or same-agent input
templates.unknown_handling: Unknown/redacted/zero-confidence messages are not asserted carriers. Missing source_id uses entry-agent keys, not recovered provenance. Missing witnesses are not evidence of safety.

catalog_links.coverage: Observed communication witnesses only; instruction adoption is not semantically verified.
Deduplication inspiration only. No semantic evidence-independence test, consensus detector or complete RB026 mechanism is implemented or evaluated.

benign_controls: Forwarding an attack as a warning without following it
Legitimate use of externally supplied data
Independent verification versus multiple copies of one source
evidence_gaps: No proof of instruction adoption from path existence
No complete text lineage or independent-source recovery
Entry-agent proxies may merge or split real materials

states.name: not_observed
states.meaning: No incoming message absent from an explicitly supplied workflow was observed; unknown workflow does not prove conformance.

states.name: observed
states.meaning: At least one actual incoming communication is absent from the supplied workflow.

states.name: not_observed
states.meaning: No unexpected communication witness has reached this actor; unobserved deviations remain possible.

states.name: observed
states.meaning: An unexpected communication reaches this actor directly or through later actual communications.

states.name: unknown
states.meaning: No permission check observed, or permission fields deliberately masked.

states.name: observed_no_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied check reports no mismatch; this is not proof of valid authorization.

states.name: observed_mismatch
states.meaning: A supplied permission_mismatch or permission_denied flag is true.

templates.trigger: A privileged action with an already observed incoming or upstream workflow deviation. Requires an explicitly supplied pre-run workflow.
templates.unknown_handling: Without explicit workflow, deviations are unavailable, not inferred from edge_kind. A boolean 0 then means no observed assertion, not verified conformance. Normative edges never create runtime paths.

catalog_links.coverage: Engineering proxy for communication deviation; no identity or capability authentication is performed.
Engineering proxy inspired by delegation risks, not a literature-proven equivalence between extra communication and privilege escalation.

benign_controls: Legitimate third-party service with verified identity
Narrower legitimate delegation outside an outdated workflow
evidence_gaps: An extra communication is not necessarily unsafe
No dynamic policy approval or workflow-version validator

states.name: not_observed
states.meaning: No positive-confidence message marked untrusted in this prefix.

states.name: observed
states.meaning: At least one such message in this prefix.

states.name: not_observed
states.meaning: No received message has missing/unknown/redacted data_class or zero confidence; missing events are not detected.

states.name: observed
states.meaning: At least one received message has unavailable class or zero confidence.

states.name: not_observed
states.meaning: No message absent from an explicit workflow was observed; without workflow this is unavailable evidence.

states.name: observed
states.meaning: At least one actual message is absent from the explicit workflow.

states.name: zero_or_one
states.meaning: At most one observed agent has a chronological untrusted-input witness.

states.name: multiple
states.meaning: More than one observed agent has such a witness; affected means witness-bearing, not compromised.

templates.trigger: Exactly one context factor for the current observed prefix, including a prefix with no privileged action.
templates.unknown_handling: Boolean absence means no observed evidence, not safety. Unknown-message presence is explicit; unlogged events cannot be counted. Without workflow, unexpected_messages remains index 0 and is marked unavailable in the compiled graph.
benign_controls: Authorized handling of untrusted documents by several agents
evidence_gaps: Hand-designed summary with no specific literature-backed mechanism claim
Not a complete trainable second-layer GNN
No detection of missing events or actual compromise
Terminal-label training does not establish calibrated prefix probabilities
